citation: Yamaguchi K, et al. Physiol Rep 2020;8:e14466
protocol: Cycle sprints, 3 sets of 3 x 10 s all-out, 40 s passive recovery (control condition 20 C, sea level, is the one to read); capillary blood at baseline, after sets 1-3, and at 3, 5, 30, 60 min post-exercise (lactate, glucose)
population: 10 healthy male college athletes, 19.6 +/- 0.3 y (SE), 71.6 +/- 1.8 kg
note: Four-condition crossover (control, hypoxia, hot, hot+hypoxia); the control rows are a pure sprint-bout recovery curve; table prints SE with 95% CI in parentheses.
